clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, the Deathstalkers turn Andron Gant's trust against him. Still believing you are the messenger he expected, Gant gives you a ledger for his secret contacts. You carry it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter, opening the way to deeper covert work for the Forsaken state.

Andron Gant works from the Undercity, keeping names and information in a personal ledger. Believing you are the courier he expected, he hands it over for delivery to the secret contacts he serves. Gant asks that the same courier carry future messages, unaware that the ledger is bound for the Deathstalkers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, this is certainly more information than I suspected to get out of Andron. Give me a moment to peruse it, before I set you to your next task.
